terms.comment: Our description, matching the lexicon’s chartula crēditōria (credit card) and ratiō argentāria (bank account, Traupman 276): argentārius is to do with banking, as in taberna argentāria, a banker’s stall (Liv. 26.11, in Lewis & Short). No reference work has a word for a debit card.

phrases.english: I’ll pay with my debit card.

sources: Lewis & Short: chartula · Lewis & Short: argentarius
